ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity base. A thick, continuous low-intensity boundary follows the trailing edge. A prominent vertical low-intensity band originates at the peduncle junction and bisects the fluke. Scattered low-intensity speckling/mottling is visible across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch; calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees with a depth ratio of roughly 0.15 relative to fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration; the left lobe trailing edge displays low-amplitude, high-frequency notches; the right lobe trailing edge displays higher-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks particularly concentrated at the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the center, transitioning to a slight concavity (recurve) near the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several localized clusters of high-intensity white pixels on the right lobe; multiple small, distinct circular low-intensity clusters (3-8 pixel diameter) on the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct horizontal low-intensity linear mark on the lower interior of the left lobe; several shorter, faint diagonal linear disruptions on the upper left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe irregular erosion and deep notches on the distal tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced wide, asymmetrical dark vertical pigmentation at the median axis junction.
